name: Pharmacy and Laboratory Management
scope_from_master_specification: Medicine catalogue/classification, prescriptions/dispensing, batches/expiry, stock, suppliers, pricing and billing; lab catalogue, sample registration/tracking, processing, result validation, reports, doctor access, equipment, inventory and quality control.
required_before_production: Pass current PR-head migration, compilation and full test CI
Complete pharmacy and laboratory clinical user acceptance testing
Approve maintained drug allergy, interaction, formulary and controlled medicine rules
Complete vendor-specific analyzer HL7/ASTM/POCT adapters and site validation
Complete insurer and payment provider sandbox/UAT and credential provisioning
Complete privacy, security, penetration and data-protection review
Complete PostgreSQL concurrency/load testing and backup/restore drills
Obtain authorized clinical, pharmacy and laboratory operational sign-off
